notes: Entrepreneurship 4 rests on the rubric's explicit inclusion of 'business software built for small businesses' as enabling. RUN's revenue share is not disclosed, and ADP's core business serves employers of all sizes, so the score is not 5. Small-business Insurance Services (280,000 small and mid-sized clients) and starter 401(k)s were treated as serving rather than enabling and were not recorded. The ADP Cares program, supported by the ADP Foundation, helps the company's own associates through hardship, so it was not counted as external community investment. The Talent Management product's learning tools and recruiter training are client HR features, not an education business, and were not counted. Tuition reimbursement and family-support benefits are part of employee development and benefits and do not change the scores. The targeted Item 7 excerpt (AI agents, ADP Marketplace for partners' AI agents) contains no qualifying activity for any theme. Business resource group quote is a continuous leading clause of a 51-word sentence; the omitted remainder lists further purposes and does not change its meaning.
